paper_title: Searching for solar axions using data from the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory
coupling_convention: isovector g3_aN in GeV^-1 (equated to |gan| assuming no cancellation)
notes: Solar axion search via axiodissociation of deuterons in SNO. Constrains isovector axion-nucleon coupling |g3_aN|=|gan-gap|/2 between 2e-5 and 1e-3 GeV^-1 for axion masses up to ~5.5 MeV. The exclusion region is a band (not a simple line); I encoded it as the boundary of the excluded box spanning masses from sub-MeV to ~5.5 MeV. Assuming no cancellation, limit applies equally to gan/gap. Note the coupling has dimension GeV^-1 (derivative coupling convention), which is non-standard vs dimensionless g_an; declared accordingly. Lower mass bound not explicitly stated (valid for sub-MeV/light axions), used 1e-22 eV as span start. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.7, 4))
